route.name: Johto League: More Map Than Progress

commentary.speaker: play_by_play
commentary.text: Tonight's interleague exhibition pairs one memoryless California walker with a Crystal correspondent who has spent the day losing an argument with Ice Path.

commentary.speaker: stats_desk
commentary.text: California revisit desk: 47.6%. The Johto desk recognizes this as the same corridor wearing a different expression.

commentary.speaker: color
commentary.text: Blackthorn can be visible and still not be a route. San Francisco can be mapped and still not be a plan.

commentary.speaker: field_reporter
commentary.text: Two hundred seven distinct segments acquired. This is officially more map than progress.

commentary.speaker: play_by_play
commentary.text: The frozen floor has become a California intersection. Different surface, identical refusal to learn anything.

commentary.speaker: stats_desk
commentary.text: Halftime: neither side has acquired a badge, a destination, or a defensible reason to continue.

commentary.speaker: color
commentary.text: Revisit rate: 56.9%. This is a route problem, not a party problem. The San Francisco entry has neither.

commentary.speaker: field_reporter
commentary.text: HPI remains zero. Johto has ice; California had every bridge removed before the walker could attempt a water-type strategy.

commentary.speaker: play_by_play
commentary.text: OH MY GOODNESS, THE EXIT IS PRACTICALLY VISIBLE—AND BOTH COMPETITORS ARE STILL WALKING PAST IT!!!!!

commentary.speaker: stats_desk
commentary.text: The marathon exhibition is complete. 99,854 city segments remain, and the commission awards the trophy for More Map Than Progress.
